newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil tribunal overturns B Band injunction - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil tribunal overturns B Band injunction - report.

text.p: A injunction to halt the privatisation of one of the 10 B Band cellular concessions has been overturned, local news agency Invest News said.
The injunction had been granted earlier this week by a federal judge in the northeastern state of Pernambuco.
It called for the government to stop the process of choosing a winner in an area comprising Alagoas, Ceara, Paraiba, Pernambuco and Rio Grande do Norte states.
But this evening the president of the 5th Regional Federal Tribunal overturned the ruling, Invest News said.
Officals from the Regional Federal Tribunal could not be reached to confirm the report.
The government put to tender a total of 10 cellular B Band concession areas on Monday and received bids from 15 consortia on all but one.

Earlier today, a Communications Ministry spokesman said the government had not halted its work as a result of the injunction because actual analysis of proposals for the area had not begun. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
